macro.label: VIX: 14.87
macro.text: S&P 500 at 7,743.41. The VIX closed a touch above the prior Friday's 14.81 after reaching 15.67 Thursday as bond yields climbed. With little paid for fear, take the strikes shown rather than moving closer to the share price for more premium.

macro.label: 10-Year Treasury Yield: 5.17%
macro.text: Crossed 5% Wednesday after two business surveys showed the strongest output in about five years alongside rising costs, and stayed above 5% through Friday. The equal-weight S&P 500, a better read on the market outside big tech, closed Thursday at a three-month low.

macro.label: Two reports decide this week
macro.text: Wednesday's inflation report and Friday's jobs report both land at 5:30 AM Pacific. Don't open a new trade in the hour before either; open it after the number is out.

macro.label: Micron reports Wednesday night
macro.text: Its numbers move chipmakers and server makers that depend on the same AI-related spending, so the chip calls below wait for Thursday morning.
